# Simplification review, round 1

## 1. TeacherSlides repeats the "save finished" reset in two places
`app/apps/web/src/features/classroom/TeacherSlides.tsx` (save, `.then` and `.catch`)

`isSaving.current = false; setMoving(null)` appears in both the success tail and the `.catch`, and `waiting.current = null` is also set in both. Extract a local `finish` (or use `.finally` for the non-chained path) so the reset exists once. As written, the `.catch` also swallows errors thrown by `cancelQueries` in the `.then` body, which is not intended; separating the mutation failure from the success tail (`.then(onSaved, onFailed)`) removes that overlap.

## 2. `?? []` on `activePolls.data` is unreachable
`app/apps/web/src/routes/_app/index.tsx` (final `FeaturedSession` render)

That branch only renders when `isFeaturedLoading` is false, which already requires `activePolls.data != null` once `featured != null`. The fallback exists only to satisfy the type. Narrowing once (e.g. computing the loaded polls and questions before the JSX) would drop the fallback and the repeated `featured == null || isFeaturedLoading` condition that mirrors the skeleton condition above it.

## 3. `useMoveSlide` keeps an `options` parameter no caller uses
`app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/useMoveSlide.ts`

`TeacherSlides` calls `useMoveSlide()` with no arguments, and `SlideMove` is exported but referenced nowhere else. Since the hook was already being reduced to a bare mutation, `options` and the `export` on `SlideMove` can be removed. (Pre-existing, but the change leaves it more obviously dead.)
EOF
